references
A bachelor’s degree in business or a related field is required, with a master’s degree preferred.
An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience that provides the required knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the duties of the position may be considered.
A minimum of two years of experience in business development, project management, sales, or a related field is required.
Experience in the health or life sciences sector is preferred.

RISE Office Management Provide clerical and administrative support for RISE-related operations, including making travel arrangements, scheduling meetings, managing calendars, organizing meeting materials, and recording and transcribing meeting minutes, as required. Process reimbursements, invoices, and other administrative financial transactions. Coordinate event logistics, including guest speaker arrangements, seminars, presentations, RSVPs, catering, room reservations, and event set-up. Provide administrative support to visitors, faculty, staff, and other constituents by responding to inquiries, assisting with routine issues, monitoring incoming and outgoing correspondence, and following up on operational commitments.

Corporate Partner Management Maintain relationships with contacts in government and industry at pharmaceutical, biotech, health care, health IT, physical science, and medical device companies. Support the cultivation of new and existing industry partners to further the Institute's goals in Team Masters Projects (TMPs), industry PhDs, PharmD fellowships, corporate education, and corporate-sponsored research. Maintain contact with current TMP sponsors to monitor quality and satisfaction with the goal of renewing the following year. Together with CP Team, secure required number of TMP contracts for the academic year based on student enrollment projections.

Advisory Board Support Support the External Advisory Boards (EAB) ensuring robust membership engagement, guidance for focused committees and leadership of the Executive Committee. Together with the CP Team, monitor effectiveness of the relationships stemming from EAB membership.

Project & Event Management Support the planning, recruiting, promoting, managing, and measuring effectiveness of events, such as External Advisory Board meetings, TMP Kick-off, PharmD fellow professional development, KGI Bioprocessing Symposium and Riggs Research Symposium. Work closely with the KGI Marketing team, Academic Affairs, Advancement, Career Services, and others in order to support events that have corporate involvement. Manage existing contract with the COPE Health Scholars program through its existing contract completion.
Data Management
Keep track of and report corporate activities in Raiser’s Edge NXT and other software services as needed. Run reports, create dashboards, and analyze data for effective decision-making.
Demonstrated experience supporting relationship management, client relations, sales, marketing, fundraising, or business development activities.
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to engage professionally with corporate partners and internal stakeholders.
Ability to support engagement activities, identify opportunities for continued interaction, and follow through on commitments.
Strong project coordination and organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet established deadlines.
Self-directed and proactive, with the ability to work independently, take initiative, and exercise sound judgment within established guidelines.
Excellent attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records, track activities, and monitor follow-up items.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, and experience using customer relationship management (CRM) systems and other business technologies.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, professional demeanor, and a customer service orientation.
Ability to collaborate effectively as a member of the RISE team and work across departments to support institutional objectives.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion.
Ability to work effectively, respectfully, and collaboratively with individuals from diverse backgrounds.
Willingness to work occasional evenings and weekends to support corporate partner activities and events.
